title: NullReferenceException when using inherited property for ValueSource

milestone.description:
Theme of this release is CONSOLIDATION.

We have rapidly extended the reach of NUnit in terms of platforms and features. For this release, we will fill in some gaps to consolidate those gains.

Key Planned Features:
* Allow multiple engines to co-exist, with differing sets of extensions installed.
* Increase use of extensions.
* Provide a way for NUnit to install it's own extensions.
* Provide a way for users to manage the extensions.
* Separate OneTimeSetUp and OneTimeTearDown work items.
* Implement a generalized dependency mechanism between work items.
* Implement parallel test case execution.
* Implement one of the proposed test dependency or ordering mechanisms.
* Integrate the Xamarin runners with NUnit in some way to be determined

body:
Consider the following test:

```
namespace NUnitTest
{
    using System;
    using NUnit.Framework;

    [TestFixture]
    public class DerivedFixture : BaseFixture
    {
        [Test]
        public void SampleTestMethod([ValueSource(nameof(MyDataSource))] int value)
        {
            Console.WriteLine("Value: " + value);
        }
    }

    public abstract class BaseFixture
    {
        public static int[] MyDataSource => new[] { 1, 2, 3 };
    }
}
```

Running this with the console runner and Visual Studio Test Adapter fails with a `NullReferenceException`:

```
C:\Projects\NUnitTest\bin\Debug>"\Program Files (x86)\NUnit.org\nunit-console\nunit3-console.exe" NUnitTest.dll
NUnit Console Runner 3.0.5797
Copyright (C) 2015 Charlie Poole

Runtime Environment
   OS Version: Microsoft Windows NT 6.3.9600.0
  CLR Version: 4.0.30319.42000

Test Files
    NUnitTest.dll


Errors and Failures

1) Invalid : NUnitTest.DerivedFixture
An exception was thrown while loading the test.
System.NullReferenceException: Object reference not set to an instance of an object.
   at NUnit.Framework.Internal.Builders.ParameterDataSourceProvider.GetDataFor(IParameterInfo parameter) in C:\Sources\Third Party\Github\nunit\src\NUnitFramework\framework\Internal\Builders\ParameterDataSourceProvider.cs:line 67
   at NUnit.Framework.CombiningStrategyAttribute.BuildFrom(IMethodInfo method, Test suite) in C:\Sources\Third Party\Github\nunit\src\NUnitFramework\framework\Attributes\CombiningStrategyAttribute.cs:line 142
   at NUnit.Framework.Internal.Builders.DefaultTestCaseBuilder.BuildFrom(IMethodInfo method, Test parentSuite) in C:\Sources\Third Party\Github\nunit\src\NUnitFramework\framework\Internal\Builders\DefaultTestCaseBuilder.cs:line 140
   at NUnit.Framework.Internal.Builders.NUnitTestFixtureBuilder.BuildTestCase(IMethodInfo method, TestSuite suite) in C:\Sources\Third Party\Github\nunit\src\NUnitFramework\framework\Internal\Builders\NUnitTestFixtureBuilder.cs:line 204
   at NUnit.Framework.Internal.Builders.NUnitTestFixtureBuilder.AddTestCasesToFixture(TestFixture fixture) in C:\Sources\Third Party\Github\nunit\src\NUnitFramework\framework\Internal\Builders\NUnitTestFixtureBuilder.cs:line 179
   at NUnit.Framework.Internal.Builders.NUnitTestFixtureBuilder.BuildFrom(ITypeInfo typeInfo, ITestFixtureData testFixtureData) in C:\Sources\Third Party\Github\nunit\src\NUnitFramework\framework\Internal\Builders\NUnitTestFixtureBuilder.cs:line 151
   at NUnit.Framework.TestFixtureAttribute.<BuildFrom>d__48.MoveNext() in C:\Sources\Third Party\Github\nunit\src\NUnitFramework\framework\Attributes\TestFixtureAttribute.cs:line 227
   at NUnit.Framework.Internal.Builders.DefaultSuiteBuilder.BuildFrom(ITypeInfotypeInfo) in C:\Sources\Third Party\Github\nunit\src\NUnitFramework\framework\Internal\Builders\DefaultSuiteBuilder.cs:line 80

Run Settings

    NumberOfTestWorkers: 12

Test Run Summary
    Overall result: Failed
   Tests run: 0, Passed: 0, Errors: 0, Failures: 0, Inconclusive: 0
     Not run: 0, Invalid: 0, Ignored: 0, Explicit: 0, Skipped: 0
  Start time: 2015-12-02 18:25:52Z

```

The issue is that [this line in `ValueSourceAttribute.GetDataSource()`](https://github.com/nunit/nunit/blob/master/src/NUnitFramework/framework/Attributes/ValueSourceAttribute.cs#L108) fails to retrieve the inherited member and so returns `null`.  The return value is subsequently not checked in the [calling code in ParameterDataSourceProvider.GetDataFor()](https://github.com/nunit/nunit/blob/master/src/NUnitFramework/framework/Internal/Builders/ParameterDataSourceProvider.cs#L67).

The [documentation for this attribute](https://github.com/nunit/nunit/wiki/ValueSource-Attribute) does not mention whether this is a supported scenario or not.  Personally I would like to see it be supported, which I believe can be done simply by adding `BindingFlags.FlattenHierarchy` to the line of code linked above.

`TestCaseSourceAttribute` has the [same code to retrieve data source members](https://github.com/nunit/nunit/blob/master/src/NUnitFramework/framework/Attributes/TestCaseSourceAttribute.cs#L218), but instead of a `NullReferenceException` the test just fails with the error "No arguments were provided".

Note: I have tested this using _nunit.framework.dll_ from the 3.0.1 Nuget release and also from master at 373dcefa70109a1a4c9a914f17561b6b4d90f977.
